description:
One-call profile of a postcode: how many suburbs it covers, population, dwellings, median age and incomes, rents, mortgages, and the mix of houses, flats and renters.

Coverage: All 2,642 postcodes we map to suburbs; population figures as at 2021-08-10. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/postcode-profile`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: suburbs_count, population, private_dwellings, occupied_private_dwellings, median_age, average_household_size, median_household_income_weekly, median_personal_income_weekly, median_rent_weekly, median_mortgage_repayment_monthly, rented_share_pct, separate_house_share_pct, flat_apartment_share_pct. Omit for all.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: postcodes_demographics_profile
title: Postcode profile
